name: macOS Core Foundation user default text encoding

files.help:
Probably not removable.

In theory, the Apple framework using this file also supports using an environment variable (_$\_\_CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING_) instead. However, [Apple's own documentation](https://developer.apple.com/library/archive/technotes/tn2228/_index.html#//apple_ref/doc/uid/DTS40007991-CH1-SUBSECTION15) warns that many other frameworks may only use the file. Therefore, it is recommended to leave this file in place unless you are willing to risk text encoding bugs.
